# containment child

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:containmentChild`](gmeow-containmentChild.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containmentChild>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The contained (child) place in this containment tenure. Functional: a tenure concerns exactly one child place.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single contained (child) place of a containment tenure; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple children on one tenure (mint one per child).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:containmentChild`](gmeow-containmentChild.md) per [`ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md).
